description:
Per-portal notice counts by status: shows which portals (e.g. TED EU, Vergabe-Bund) are covered and how many notices each contributes. Counts match vergabe_liste exactly (same visibility gate, same stale-deadline exclusion). No rate limit. One optional parameter.

Example user questions: "Welche Vergabeportale sind in der Suche enthalten?"; "Wie viele EU-Ausschreibungen sind verfügbar?"; "Woher kommen die Daten in der Vergabe-Suche?"

include_dead.description: Include notices with dead portal URLs in the counts.

name: vergabe_quellen
title: Vergabe-Quellen
